ingredients.name: apples, such as Honeycrisp, cored, unpeeled and cut into 1-inch chunks

steps.instruction: Put the oven rack in the center and preheat to 350 °F.
Place 3 cut-up apples and 1/2 cup of raisins in an 8-inch square pan.
Add the juice of 1/2 lemon and toss.
In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup of oats, 1/4 cup of whole wheat flour and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Add 3 tablespoons of brown sugar and 1/4 cup of chopped pistachios.
Add 2 tablespoons of melted butter or margarine and mix until the texture is even.
Sprinkle the mixture over the apples and raisins.
Bake uncovered for 45 minutes, until the apples are tender.
steps.spoken: Bake uncovered for 45 to fifty minutes, until the apples are tender.

ingredients.name: wild salmon fillets, 24 ounces total, with skin, pin bones removed

steps.instruction: Put 1/3 cup of soy sauce and 3 tablespoons of rice wine vinegar in a blender.
Add 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, 2 teaspoons curry powder and 1 tablespoon ginger.
Add 5 cloves of garlic, 1/4 cup of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of dark brown sugar.
Add 2 teaspoons of black pepper and 1 1/2 tablespoons of curry paste.
Blend until smooth.
Pour the sauce into a plastic bag and add the 4 salmon fillets.
Toss the salmon to coat it with the sauce.
Seal the bag, pressing out as much air as you can.
Refrigerate the bag for 4 hours.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate the bag for up to 4 hours.

steps.instruction: Heat 4 1/2 pounds of charcoal in a chimney starter.
Spread the coals evenly on the bottom of the grill and put the grate back.
Take the salmon out of the marinade and throw the marinade away.
Let the salmon sit at room temperature until the coals are hot.
Once the grate is hot, quickly wipe it with a towel.
Place the salmon skin side up on the hottest part of the grill.
Cook the salmon for 3 minutes, then flip it.
steps.spoken: Cook for 3 to five minutes for medium. Halfway through, turn each fillet a quarter turn to get grill marks.

steps.instruction: Cook the other side for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook the other side for 3 to five minutes. Halfway through, turn each fillet a quarter turn to get grill marks.

steps.instruction: Put the salmon on a plate and cover it tightly with foil for 5 minutes.
Move the salmon to warmed plates.
Sprinkle on 2 tablespoons of basil and 1/4 cup of chopped cilantro.
Put 1 inch of water in a 4-quart pot with a lid.
Set a steamer basket inside the pot.
Place 20 medium asparagus spears in the steamer basket.
Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce to medium heat and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 5 to ten minutes, until the asparagus is easily pierced with a sharp knife. Do not overcook.

steps.instruction: Grate the zest of the lemon into a small bowl.
Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.
steps.spoken: Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl. Press out the extra juice with the back of a spoon and remove any pits.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon of dried parsley.
Stir in 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper and 1/16 teaspoon of salt.
steps.spoken: Stir in the pepper and salt. Stir well, then set the sauce aside.

steps.instruction: Remove the pot from the heat.
Place the asparagus spears in a serving bowl.
Drizzle the lemon sauce evenly over the asparagus.
steps.spoken: Drizzle the lemon sauce evenly over the asparagus, about 1 1/2 teaspoons for each serving.

steps.instruction: Snap the tough ends off 12 asparagus spears.
Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Salt the water lightly.
Add the asparagus spears.
steps.spoken: Add the asparagus spears and cook at a lively simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Lift the spears out with tongs and set them aside.
steps.spoken: Lift the spears out with tongs and set them aside. Keep the cooking water.

steps.instruction: Heat 3 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan.
Add 1 chopped medium shallot and cook gently until soft but not browned.
Add the cooked asparagus spears and 1 cup of the cooking water.
Cook at a lively simmer for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bring it to a boil, then cook at a lively simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat.
Strain the soup through a medium sieve into a bowl, keeping the liquid.
Purée the solids in a food processor with enough of the liquid to be smooth.
Rub the purée through the sieve back into the saucepan.
steps.spoken: Strain the purée through the sieve back into the saucepan, rubbing it through with a flexible scraper or wooden spoon and leaving the fibrous parts in the sieve.

steps.instruction: Throw away what is left in the sieve.
Add 1/4 to 1 cup of cream and enough of the remaining cooking water.
Season with salt, black pepper and cayenne pepper to taste.
Reheat gently over low heat, without letting the soup boil.
Serve the soup hot, or chill it to serve cold.
steps.spoken: Serve hot. To serve chilled, let it cool, then refrigerate it uncovered until thoroughly cold, then cover with plastic wrap. It keeps in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eat Smart New York!, Cornell University Cooperative Extension

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of asparagus to a large pot of boiling water.
steps.spoken: Cook the asparagus for about 4 minutes, until it is tender.

steps.instruction: Drain the asparagus and rinse it with cold water to cool it quickly.
Drain the asparagus again.
Pat the asparagus dry.
Wrap the asparagus in a paper towel, then plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the asparagus.
Melt 2 tablespoons of margarine in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 teaspoons of lemon peel and 1 minced garlic clove.
steps.spoken: Add the lemon peel and garlic and stir for 30 seconds.

steps.instruction: Add the asparagus and toss to coat.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of lemon juice over the asparagus.
Sauté for about 3 minutes, until the asparagus is heated through and coated.
Transfer the asparagus to a platter.

avocado-potato-and-grilled-chicken-salad.title: Avocado Potato and Grilled Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: grilled chicken strips, frozen, pre-cooked, thawed and cut into bite-size pieces

steps.instruction: Boil 3 medium red potatoes in a medium saucepan for about 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil the potatoes for about 20 minutes, until they are just tender.

steps.instruction: Run the potatoes under cold water to cool them.
Cut the potatoes into chunks.
Peel the avocado and cut it into chunks.
Coat the avocado with 1 teaspoon of lemon juice.
Whisk 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of cider vinegar in a small bowl.
Whisk in 1/2 cup of lemon yogurt and 1 teaspoon of black pepper.
Place the potatoes and avocado in a large bowl.
Add 4 chopped green onions and 1/2 medium chopped red bell pepper.
Add 8 ounces of thawed chicken strips, cut into bite-size pieces.
Add the dressing.
Gently toss everything together.
Mix 1/2 cup of wine, 1 minced garlic clove, salt and pepper.
Marinate 12 shucked oysters in the mixture for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Marinate the oysters in the mixture for 10 to twenty minutes.

steps.instruction: Preheat the broiler.
Cut each of the 6 bacon slices in half.
Wrap each oyster in a piece of bacon and secure it with a toothpick.
Broil on both sides until the bacon is crisp.
steps.spoken: Broil on both sides until the bacon is crisp. You may also cook them on an outdoor or rangetop grill.

ingredients.name: black beans, 15.5 ounces, low-sodium, drained and rinsed
diced tomatoes, 14.5 ounces each, low-sodium, drained

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse 1 can of black beans.
Put the beans and 2 drained cans of diced tomatoes in a large mixing bowl.
Dice 1 green bell pepper, 1 red bell pepper, 1 onion and 2 cloves of garlic.
Add the diced vegetables to the mixing bowl.
Mix 2 teaspoons of cumin, 1 teaspoon of dried cilantro and 3 tablespoons of vinegar.
Pour the spice mixture over the beans and vegetables.
Stir well.
Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Line a muffin tin with paper liners, or just grease the tin.
Mix 2 cups of flour and 1 cup of sugar in a large bowl.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
In another bowl, whisk 1/2 cup of melted butter and 1 cup of milk.
Whisk in 2 large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir until just combined.
steps.spoken: Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.instruction: Gently fold in 1 1/2 cups of fresh blueberries.
Spoon the batter into the tin, filling each cup about 3/4 full.
Bake for 20 minutes, until a toothpick in a muffin comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-five minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Take the muffins out and let them cool in the tin for a few minutes.
Move the muffins to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

ingredients.name: leeks, split lengthwise, sliced thin and rinsed well
carrots, peeled and cut into thin sticks
red potatoes, sliced into 1/2-inch thick circles

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pan.
Add 2 cups of sliced leeks and 3 medium carrots.
steps.spoken: Cook gently for 3 to five minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften.

steps.instruction: Add 4 sliced red potatoes and 2 cups of chicken broth.
Add 2 tablespoons of parsley, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 10 to twelve minutes, until the vegetables are just tender.

steps.instruction: Add the 4 cod fillets to the pan.
Cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid and cook over low heat.
steps.spoken: Cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, until the fish is white and flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part. A thermometer reads 145 °F there.

steps.instruction: Serve each fillet with 1 1/2 cups of broth and vegetables.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eating Smart, Being Active, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 425 °F.
Grease the bottoms of a muffin tin with cooking spray.
Put 1/2 cup all-purpose flour and 3/4 cup whole wheat flour in a large bowl.
Mix in 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 teaspoons baking soda and 1/2 cup sugar.
Stir in 1 3/4 cups of bran flake cereal with raisins and mix well.
Make a well in the center of the mixture.
In another bowl, beat 1 egg, 1 cup buttermilk and 2 tablespoons oil together.
Pour the egg mixture into the well and stir until all is moist.
steps.spoken: Pour the egg mixture into the well and stir until everything is moist. Do not over mix.

steps.instruction: Fill the muffin tin cups 2/3 full.
Bake for 15 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 15 to twenty minutes, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Wrap leftover muffins in foil or a plastic bag and freeze them.
Thaw frozen muffins for 15 seconds in the microwave, or overnight in the refrigerator.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Scrub 6 medium potatoes.
Prick the skin of each potato with a fork in several places.
Bake the potatoes for 30 minutes, until soft.
steps.spoken: Bake the potatoes for 30 to sixty minutes, until soft. Larger potatoes take longer.

steps.instruction: Peel the stems of 3 broccoli stalks.
Steam the broccoli just until tender.
Chop the broccoli into small pieces.
Cut the baked potatoes in half.
Scoop the insides of the potatoes into a bowl with the broccoli.
Add 1/4 cup of milk, 3/4 cup of cheese, salt and pepper.
Mash together until the mixture is pale green with dark green flecks.
Put the potato mixture into the potato skins.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese on top.
Microwave until heated through.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style

steps.instruction: Rinse 2 pounds of green beans and snap off the tips.
Place the green beans in a large pot.
Add 1/2 cup of cold water.
Cook the green beans over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Spray a sauté pan with cooking spray.
Add 1/3 cup of chopped onions and 4 cloves of chopped garlic.
steps.spoken: Sauté the onions and garlic for 5 minutes, or until they are tender and very lightly browned.

steps.instruction: Add the onions, garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper to the green beans.
Spray cooking spray over the mixture.
Cook on medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook on medium heat for another 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the green beans are tender but not soft.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of dried basil and 1/2 teaspoon of dried oregano over the beans.
Mix and serve.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Rub 5 to 6 thighs with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper.
Place the thighs skin-side down in a cold skillet.
Cook over medium-low heat for 15 minutes without touching them.
Stir 1/3 cup of honey and 2 tablespoons of hot sauce together in a bowl.
Flip the thighs and cook for 10 more minutes.
Move the thighs to a baking tray and drizzle sauce on both sides.
steps.spoken: Move the thighs to a baking tray, or leave them in the skillet if it is cast iron. Drizzle the sauce on both sides to coat them. You do not have to use all of it.

steps.instruction: Bake the thighs for 15 minutes.
Check the thickest thigh with a thermometer for 165 °F.
steps.spoken: Check the thickest thigh with a thermometer. It should read 165 °F.

steps.instruction: If you like, baste with the leftover sauce and bake 5 more minutes.
steps.spoken: If you like, baste the thighs a second time with the leftover sauce, and bake 5 more minutes. You can make more sauce if you need it.

steps.instruction: Let the thighs cool a few minutes, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: cooked chicken, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.instruction: Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add 8 ounces of sliced mushrooms and 1 small chopped red pepper.
Add 1 small chopped onion and 1 clove of minced garlic.
Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of flour over the vegetables and stir.
Slowly whisk in 4 cups of milk.
Whisk in 2 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, stirring now and then.
Add 8 ounces of extra broad egg noodles to the pot.
steps.spoken: Add the noodles. Cook about 7 minutes, until the noodles are tender.

steps.instruction: Reduce the heat to a low boil.
Stir constantly, including around the edges, until the noodles are tender.
Stir in 5 ounces of garlic and herb soft cheese, in chunks.
Stir in 3 cups of cooked chicken, 1/2 cup of peas and 1/2 cup of parsley.
Keep stirring until the chicken is hot and the cheese is melted.
Sprinkle with grated parmesan and small fresh basil leaves.
Grease 2 loaf pans or line them with parchment paper.
Preheat the oven to 325 °F.
Mix 2 cups of flour, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of baking powder.
steps.spoken: Mix 2 cups of flour, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of baking powder. Sifting them is optional.

steps.instruction: Add 1 teaspoon each of baking soda, cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of grated ginger.
Beat 2 cups of sugar and 3/4 cup of butter in a large bowl.
Add 2 eggs to the sugar and butter, one at a time.
Beat in 1 can of pumpkin.
Whisk in the flour mixture.
Pour the batter into the loaf pans.
Bake for 75 minutes, to make 2 loaves.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 75 minutes. This makes 2 loaves.

steps.instruction: Bring 1 1/4 cups of water and 1 cup of porridge rice to a boil in a deep pot.
Boil the rice for 2 minutes, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Boil the rice at a steady heat for about 2 minutes, stirring all the time.

steps.instruction: Add 4 cups of whole milk to the pot.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Boil on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Boil on low heat for about 10 minutes, still stirring all the time.

steps.instruction: Put the lid on the pot.
Boil for 30 minutes, stirring often.
steps.spoken: Boil for about 30 minutes and stir often. If the porridge looks too thin, boil it for another 5 to ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 pinches of salt.
Mix 4 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon in a bowl.
Serve warm with cinnamon sugar on top and a bit of butter in the middle.
steps.spoken: Serve warm with the cinnamon sugar on top and a bit of butter in the middle. You need 3 1/2 tablespoons of butter in all.
